body.label: Trigger
body.html: You or an ally within 4 units is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense against the triggering Action. If the target is Possessed, increase this bonus by 1.

surges.html: Increase the Defense bonus from this Reaction by 1.
If the target is Possessed, after the triggering Action resolves you may resolve one of your Rites affecting it once without reducing remaining Echoes.
